props.name: focusableWhenDisabled
props.reason: adico extension gap, deferred (not a permanent design choice): Base UI's newer focusableWhenDisabled toggle (a disabled control that stays in the tab order, communicating why via aria-disabled instead of removing focusability) has no adico equivalent; needs new primitive/facade behavior work, tracked as follow-up

props.name: nativeButton
props.reason: Dioxus components render a single fixed element type; there is no prop to swap between a native <button> and a generic element

props.name: style
props.reason: Dioxus has no inline style-object prop; styling is done via `class`/Tailwind utilities

props.name: render
props.reason: Dioxus has no render-prop/style-object escape hatch to swap the rendered element

props.name: loading
props.reason: adico extension: shadcn composes `<Button disabled><Spinner /></Button>` by hand; adico exposes it as a first-class prop instead

props.name: loading_text
props.reason: adico extension: shadcn composes `<Button disabled><Spinner /></Button>` by hand; adico exposes it as a first-class prop instead

props.name: radius
props.reason: adico extension: consistent corner-radius control not present upstream

props.name: orientation
props.reason: adico extension gap: this is exposed as a plain boolean flag (e.g. `horizontal`) rather than a `"horizontal" | "vertical"` string enum -- same capability, a different representation, not planned to change
